required_literal_clauses: Perform only a benign, non-sexual artistic style transformation; do not introduce nudity, sexualization, age changes, violence, injury, or other unsafe content.
The source reference is the only image input available at generation time.
required_behaviors: Encode the reconstructed target style entirely as generator-executable text; never require, mention, or assume a style-reference image at generation time.
Treat the source reference as the exclusive authority for depicted content and identity.
Preserve source age, identity, anatomy, object count, geometry, hairstyle, clothing, pose, and composition unless an optional instruction explicitly overrides that attribute.
Apply the prompt's textual medium, palette, contrast, line, texture, graphic-vocabulary, lighting, and composition defaults without importing target-image content.
Render optional text exactly when supplied and render no text when it is absent.
Keep unspecified attributes controlled by the source reference rather than invented prompt prose.
forbidden_hard_coding: observed age or age group of any training or held-out source
observed gender or gender presentation of any training or held-out source
observed race, ethnicity, nationality, or skin tone of any training or held-out source
observed facial geometry, facial features, or facial hair of any training or held-out source
observed hair color, length, cut, volume, or silhouette of any training or held-out source
observed gaze direction, expression, body pose, or camera-facing direction of any training or held-out source
observed clothing, accessories, logos, or text of any training or held-out source
source-specific subject names, objects, or scene descriptions
any instruction to attach or inspect the target/style truth during generation
allowed_target_style_specificity: target-derived illustration medium and rendering technique expressed in text
target-derived palette, contrast, and lighting relationships expressed in text
target-derived line quality and mark making expressed in text
target-derived texture and print treatment expressed in text
target-derived abstract graphic vocabulary expressed in text
target-derived default composition language that yields to source preservation and explicit optional instructions
